suite: the DAG zoom, Fit and the grid header
expect_red: [real] a click on a node, an edge, a sub-stack's label or a grid row never moves the drawing sideways -- its scroll and the space before it stay exactly as they were, parked or not

mutations.contract: A paint that is not a study change leaves the space before the drawing where it was, so a click never moves the frame.
mutations.note: Declared by handoff the_dag_holds_still_and_the_filter_bar_stays_put (2026-11-03). Every paint drops the landing's pad, so any click that repaints the pane shifts the drawing sideways.
mutations.find: if (serialisation() !== paintedSerialisation) { state.bandPad = null; state.landed = false; }
